title.en: Light and Shadow: From Observation to Evidence

subtitle.zh: 虚构学习指南 · 用小实验解释影子的变化
subtitle.en: Fictional learner guide · Explain changing shadows through a small experiment

value.zh: 一张观察记录与一段解释
value.en: One observation record and a short explanation

notice.zh: 这是用于测试版式和交互的虚构原型，不是实际课程要求。
notice.en: This fictional prototype tests layout and interaction. It is not an actual course requirement.

lead.zh: 先提出预测，再用可重复的观察检查它。
lead.en: Make a prediction, then check it with repeatable observations.

text.zh: 能描述光源距离变化时影子的变化，并用至少两条观察证据解释你的结论。
text.en: Describe how a shadow changes as the light source moves, and explain your conclusion using at least two observations.

text.zh: 材料：小手电筒、不透明积木、白纸和直尺。实验前与同伴约定：哪一个变量改变，哪几个条件保持不变？
text.en: Materials: a small flashlight, an opaque block, white paper and a ruler. Before experimenting, agree with your partner: which variable changes, and which conditions stay the same?

text.zh: 请勿把光直接照向眼睛。让桌面保持整洁，并将电线移出走道。
text.en: Do not shine light directly into anyone’s eyes. Keep the table clear and cables out of walkways.

items.zh: 5 分钟：画出装置，写下一条可以检验的预测。
items.en: 5 minutes: sketch the setup and write one testable prediction.

items.zh: 15 分钟：保持积木与白纸的位置不变，改变光源距离；每次记录影子宽度。
items.en: 15 minutes: keep the block and paper fixed, change the light-source distance, and record the shadow width each time.

items.zh: 10 分钟：重复测量，检查结果是否一致。
items.en: 10 minutes: repeat measurements and check consistency.

items.zh: 10 分钟：与同伴比较证据，写出解释。
items.en: 10 minutes: compare evidence with your partner and write an explanation.

items.zh: 5 分钟：整理器材，完成离堂反思。
items.en: 5 minutes: put away equipment and complete the exit reflection.

rows.zh: 光源到积木的距离（厘米）
rows.en: Distance from light source to block (cm)

rows.zh: 影子宽度与重复测量结果（厘米）
结论、两条证据及一项局限
rows.en: A conclusion, two pieces of evidence and one limitation

items.zh: 哪一条观察最支持你的解释？
items.en: Which observation best supports your explanation?

items.zh: 如果重新实验，你会怎样提高测量的一致性？
items.en: If you repeated the experiment, how would you improve measurement consistency?
